nodes.description: Mapping _onSaleNum: per-address count of outgoing sale transfers, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Mapping canSale: address whitelist granting skip of the sale-limit checks inside ensure.
uint256 _minSale: minimum allowed transfer value, configured by init and read by condition.
uint256 _maxSale: maximum allowed transfer value, configured by init and read by condition.
uint256 _saleNum: per-address sale count limit, configured by init and read by condition.
address tradeAddress: privileged transfer-exempt address written by setTradeAddress and consulted in ensure.
Mapping balanceOf: public token balances mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Mapping allowance: public nested approval mapping mutated by approve and transferFrom.
uint constant decimals = 18 used for supply and sale-limit scaling.
uint totalSupply: total token supply assigned in the constructor.
string name: token name assigned in the constructor.
string symbol: token symbol assigned in the constructor.
address owner: privileged account set from msg.sender and used for every access-control check.
address constant UNI: hardcoded Uniswap router address referenced for the router pair.
function transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
function ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view: whitelist bypass plus sale-limit condition, computes UNI pair via pairFor.
function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable: allowance check, ensure() call, balance and _onSaleNum mutation, Transfer emit.
function approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
function condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view: enforces per-address sale count and min/max value limits.
function delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable: owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall.
function init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public: owner-gated configuration of _minSale, _maxSale, _saleNum.
function batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable: owner-gated loop distributing balances and emitting duplicate Transfer events.
function setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-gated write of tradeAddress.
function pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure: creates the deterministic Uniswap pair address.
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable: sets metadata, supply, owner and initial balance.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for authorization and allowance keying.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate: executes attacker-supplied code in the contract storage context.
